name: OpenAPI MCP Server
description: A generic MCP server that dynamically converts OpenAPI-defined REST APIs into tools for LLMs like Claude. It supports multiple authentication methods and transport protocols, enabling seamless interaction with any OpenAPI-compliant API.

rawRecord.description: A generic MCP server that dynamically converts OpenAPI-defined REST APIs into tools for LLMs like Claude. It supports multiple authentication methods and transport protocols, enabling seamless interaction with any OpenAPI-compliant API.

NAMESPACE.description: Namespace for the MCP server tools.

TOOLS_MODE.description: Tools loading mode: "all" (load all endpoint-based tools), "dynamic" (load only meta-tools), or "explicit" (load only tools specified in includeTools).

API_HEADERS.description: Comma-separated key:value pairs for API authentication headers (e.g., "Authorization:Bearer token123,X-API-Key:your-api-key").

API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for the API endpoints.

INCLUDE_TAGS.description: Comma-separated list of OpenAPI tags to include.

OPENAPI_SPEC_PATH.description: Path or URL to the OpenAPI specification file (JSON or YAML).

INCLUDE_OPERATIONS.description: Comma-separated list of HTTP methods (e.g., GET, POST) to include.

OPENAPI_SPEC_INLINE.description: The OpenAPI specification content provided directly as a string.

DISABLE_ABBREVIATION.description: Set to "true" to disable tool name optimization/abbreviation.

OPENAPI_SPEC_FROM_STDIN.description: Set to "true" to read the OpenAPI specification from standard input.
